Which statement about cobalt(II) chloride and copper(II) sulfate is correct?
A
The blue form of cobalt(II) chloride is hydrated.
B
The pink form of cobalt(II) chloride is chemically combined with water.
C
The white form of copper(II) sulfate contains water.
D
The blue form of copper(II) sulfate is anhydrous.
